transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well, I'm here because... honestly, I've been having some pretty dark thoughts lately. I keep thinking that maybe my family would just be better off if I went to sleep and didn't wake up. It got to the point where it really scared me, so I ended up mentioning it to my supervisor at work, and they suggested I come in.
Have you had any specific plans or taken any steps toward ending your life?

No, no. I haven't made any actual plans or... or taken any steps. I haven't bought anything or figured out a way to do it, if that's what you mean. It's really just been those heavy thoughts in my head about not waking up. Like I said, it scared me, so I haven't tried to actually act on it.
Have you been feeling down, depressed, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy, especially over the past couple of weeks?

Yeah, I'd say so. Both of those things, really. I just don't care for much of anything right now. I used to like messing with my tomato plants, or sanding wood out at my bench... watching the Falcons play, even just staying after church to talk with folks. But lately, I don't know. I just look at all that stuff like it belongs to somebody else. I just don't have any interest in doing any of it anymore.
Have you been feeling like you have no energy or have been unusually tired most days, even when you're not doing much?

No, I wouldn't say that. My energy is... well, it's about normal, I guess. I'm not physically worn out or dragging around. I just don't have the drive to actually go do those things I mentioned. But as far as just being tired all the time, no, not really.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently, like eating less than usual or losing weight without trying?

Yeah, my appetite's definitely been off. Most days I really have to force myself to just take a few bites of something. Even the stuff I usually like eating, whether I'm at the warehouse or just sitting at home... I'll fix it, but it just sits there. I usually end up just throwing it in the trash. I just don't have a taste for anything right now.
How long have you been feeling this way, with the low mood and loss of interest in things?
I'd say it's been right about two weeks now. This whole change in me... well, it pretty much started right when my daughter left Georgia to go into the military.
Have you felt like you're not worth much or blamed yourself for things more than usual lately?

Yeah, I have. I just keep going over and over my daughter leaving. I can't help but tell myself I must have failed her somehow. Like, if I was a better father, I would have done something different... been better for her. It just weighs on me a lot right now.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, feeling restless or fidgety in a way that's different from how you normally are?

Yeah, I have been a lot slower. The guys at work... they actually keep asking me if I'm sick. I guess I'm just walking a lot slower than normal around the floor. And when someone asks me a simple question, it just takes me forever to actually answer them. It really just feels like... I don't know, like my whole body is moving through mud lately.
Have you ever had a period like this before, where you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks?
Well, yeah. Looking back at it, these low stretches... they've been coming around for about a year now. But this one right here, right after my daughter left, it's definitely hit me the hardest.
Compared to those previous low stretches you mentioned, how is this current one affecting your ability to function at work and in your daily life?

It's... it's definitely worse this time around. At work, my mistakes have gotten pretty serious. It actually got bad enough that a supervisor found me just sitting out in my truck before dawn one morning... and they ended up getting occupational health involved. And at home, it's not much better. I've just let the bills and regular responsibilities pile up on the counter instead of handling them like I normally would.
Would you say that your slowed movements and thinking are preventing you from doing some of the things you need to do in your day?

Yeah, I'd say that's exactly it. When I'm moving this slow, and my head feels this thick, I just... I can't keep up with what I'm supposed to be doing. Like with the bills I mentioned, I look at them, but my brain just doesn't want to process it. And at work, I just can't get out ahead of things like I need to. So, yeah, it's definitely stopping me from getting my regular stuff done.
Between your previous low periods and this current one, did you notice any time when your mood actually improved significantly before this latest episode started?

Yeah, actually. Right before this current low spell hit, there was a stretch where I felt... well, different. I was either feeling way too fired up, like everything was finally going my way, or I was just snapping at folks over small things I'd normally let slide. It was like I was running hot, either in a good way or an irritable way, right before I crashed into this.
How long did your previous low periods last, and were there clear periods where you felt back to normal before this latest episode started?

Well, those older low stretches... they'd usually stick around for a while. A few weeks, maybe a month or two? But as for feeling back to normal before this one... I'm not really sure. I mean, I told you about that time I was running hot just before this crash, but as for a clear, normal time between the old lows and this... I just can't say for certain. It all kind of blurs together when you're looking back at it.
Before this current low period started, did you ever have a time when your mood was unusually high or you felt like you didn’t need much sleep and were more active or talkative than usual?

Yeah, I did. I had so much energy for a while there. I'd be up way before daylight, just... planning out all these new changes for the warehouse. And then I'd be at home cleaning out the garage, just jumping right from one job to the next. I really didn't even want to stop. I just kept going and going.
